description: This file is a Streamlit web app page for uploading, processing, and managing PDF chapters related to medical textbooks. It handles file uploads, metadata input, PDF processing, embedding generation, storage, and chapter management including deletion.

classes.name: LangchainPDFProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing PDF files into chunks of text.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class managing the creation of embeddings for text chunks.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for storing and retrieving embeddings in a local vector database.

methods.name: get_embeddings
methods.description: Asynchronous function to batch embed text chunks using EmbeddingManager.
